newsitem.title: BELARUS: Belarus 96 beet crop slips, refined imports soon.
newsitem.headline: Belarus 96 beet crop slips, refined imports soon.

text.p: Belarus's 1996 sugar beet harvest was 1.0 million tonnes compared with 1.142 million in 1995, and refined sugar output rose to 225,500 tonnes from 140,000 tonnes in 1995, the Statistics Ministry said on Thursday.
A government official said separately that Belarus planned to buy 30,000 tonnes of refined sugar "in the near future" due to shortages in the former Soviet republic of 10 million people.
The official said Belarus would make an exception for the planned import by lifting a 30 percent tariff that it slapped on refined sugar imports in October 1996.
The tariff has especially hit neighbouring Ukraine, a traditional sugar exporter to Belarus.
The official did say from which country Minsk would import.
The Statistics Ministry reported that 1996 refined output data included 93,100 tonnes from imported raws, up from 1995's 12,400 tonnes.
